title: The secret behind Joel's broken watch in The Last of Us
subject: joel
description:
Did you ever notice Joel's watch? 👇

The hidden meaning of the broken watch Joel Miller wears through The Last of Us. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I and Part II.

tags: the last of us easter eggs

scenes.text: Joel wore a broken watch for twenty years.
Sarah gave it to him on his birthday, the night the outbreak began.
She died hours later. By the time he met Ellie, the glass was cracked and the hands were still.
But here's the strange part. He never fixed it, and he never replaced it.
Fans believe the frozen watch shows that part of Joel stopped living that night.
In Part II, after he is gone, Ellie finds it in a box on his bed.
It was the last piece of Sarah he refused to let go.
